cause: Seed 1 easy, Nether, row 49636: C attacks and kills magma cube 12635; Java leaves it at one health. C adds stat.useItem.267 and stat.damageDealt and wears the sword, while Java adds only stat.playOneMinute that row. Java EntitySlime.setDead calls spawnEntityInWorld after setting a split child's size and pose, so its tracker sends S0F from the spawn pose. C's sr_track_spawn skipped slimes and magma cubes, registering the child only at combat_server_finish after its first movement. The S0F for cube 12635 put C's client copy at scaled x/z -3018/-3883 against Java -3020/-3882. The z shift kept C's copy on an adjacent block while Java's fell below the attack ray. The fix registers the tracker in sr_track_spawn and sets the child size before that callback. The full 87382-row recording is equal through its last row.
